The '''Worru'du system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Torranix sector/Legends|Torranix sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Worru'du]].
